content.short: Usual is a decentralized protocol issuing USD0, a stablecoin fully backed by Real-World Assets.
content.description: Usual is a next-generation stablecoin protocol that issues USD0, a digital asset fully backed 1:1 by high-quality Real-World Assets, such as short-term US Treasury Bills. Designed as a transparent and decentralized alternative to traditional centralized stablecoins, Usual allows users to hold a secure, RWA-collateralized asset while participating in the protocol's governance through the USUAL token. The platform focuses on redistributing value back to its users and ensuring the highest standards of on-chain transparency, redistributing protocol ownership and revenue to those who provide liquidity.
content.meta: Usual is a decentralized protocol for RWA-backed stablecoins, featuring the USD0 asset. Discover Usual and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
